verdict.rationale: Brex documents instant virtual card creation, including one-click virtual cards for vendor bill payments and API or integration-driven virtual card issuance, plus spend limits for procurement. A community user also praises the dynamic card generator. However, nothing in the pack shows a card can be locked to a single merchant or vendor, or set up for recurring SaaS subscriptions, so the isolation the story asks for is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit single-vendor/merchant-lock controls on virtual cards, SaaS subscription card workflows, documentation of per-vendor isolation or limits, hands-on corroboration.
